snippet.title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe - Booster Course Pass - Wave 1 Launch
snippet.description:
Get racing with 8 new classic Mario Kart courses! Wave 1 of the #MarioKart 8 Deluxe - Booster Course Pass is available now!

The Booster Course Pass is available for free to Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack members, or can be purchased on its own.
